name: clayclaude
description: An always-on tablet board for your Claude Code sessions, with clay characters.
author: Jonathan Avis

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'web/dist']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.postbuild: mkdir -p dist/probe dist/hooks dist/hotkey && cp src/probe/probe.py dist/probe/ && cp src/hooks/clayclaude-hook.py dist/hooks/ && cp src/hotkey/clayclaude-hotkey.ahk dist/hotkey/
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web && tsc -p tools/perf
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
